messages:
Jordan (sec-eng): Heads-up: after last night's RBAC sweep we got a small burst of mTLS failures in ap-northeast when the rotator tried to refresh cert chains.
Elena (infra): Any sample trace?
Jordan (sec-eng): Proxy log sample: ```
2026-03-29T03:18:12Z proxy-ap tls: unwrap failed: KMS AccessDenied principal=role/region-keystore-rotator key=alias/region-keystore
```
Tobias (sre): I saw ~25s of 5xx from svc-ingest -> svc-transform at 03:18, canary nodes first. Not global.
AuditBot: ALERT KMS_DENY_20260329: 9 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/region-keystore-rotator between 2026-03-29T03:17:58Z and 2026-03-29T03:18:30Z. Saved to /logs/sec/kms/2026-03-29/KMS_DENY_20260329.json
Jordan (sec-eng): Hypothesis: RBAC removed decrypt on the rotator role; fallback cache TTL is low and several pods attempted fresh decrypts during a rolling restart.
Elena (infra): Mitigation plan: push a timeboxed infra patch granting kms:Decrypt to service-account/proxy-fanout for alias/region-keystore for 20m via CI job (no console edits). Bump proxy cache TTL to 4m on canary.
Tobias (sre): I'll run the emergency job: `./infra/iam-hotfix --grant "proxy-fanout:kms:Decrypt:alias/region-keystore" --duration 20m --tag mtls-handshake-20260329`
RollbackBot: Job j-559 started by Tobias (sre). Change logged.
Tobias (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/5, cache TTL increased. Observability shows errors back to baseline within ~35s. No further denies recorded after regrant.
Jordan (sec-eng): Postmitigation actions: (1) postmortem + timeline, (2) add RBAC rollout preflight that simulates KMS decrypt as the rotator principal, (3) default proxy cache TTL -> 3m, (4) update rotator to return cached chain on decrypt failure and include a circuit-breaker, (5) retain KMS deny logs 90d.
Elena (infra): I'll open the infra PR adding a preflight: `aws kms decrypt --key-id alias/region-keystore --profile rotator-principal || exit 1` and add an observability gate to fail canary if KMS Deny > 0 for 1m.
Tobias (sre): I'll add a CI fault-injection that returns KMS Deny for rotator path to validate fallback.
AuditBot: Snapshot of deny events attached to ticket SEC-4999; retention set to 90d.
Jordan (sec-eng): Thanks team. I'll own the postmortem doc and runbook updates. Close here unless new alerts. :lock:
